top_signals.title: Treasury minister: ‘I don’t think employers are working people’
top_signals.summary: A top treasury minister has said she does not think “employers are working people” – reigniting fierce debate over whether Labour broke its manifesto pledge not to raise taxes for working people. In its 2024 election manifesto, Labour vowed not to increase taxes on ‘working people’, ruling out hikes to income tax, employee National Insurance [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
